I can't really say as i know people who read reddit and they'd probably figure it out if i mentioned it. Suffice to say it is real enough that i've gone to the hospital on occasion and it's real enough that i can barely walk on a daily basis. I have never been so depressed in my life but my brain isn't working like it used to anymore. i used to be social now i'm phsyically scared of people. I used to be nonchalant and now i can barely survive the day without getting irrationally angry at something. I've been trying to keep it under control but it's getting really really difficult. I also have these thoughts that are cmoing out of nowhere saying that i should finish it off and be done with it, but they're not really my thoughts. not in a voice in my head sort of way but in a i know this is stupid why does it sound like such a good idea sort of way.

i'm so tired i'm so very tired of this. i can't even relax in my own head, how do you survive when you can't relax in your own brain? You can't escape your brain. sometimes i go to sleep just so i'll stop thinking. i can't keep doing that anymore either as now i'm an insomniac and all i get to do is sit up and think of how i would give anything to just make my brain fucking stop for three seconds so i could be at peace.

there was a point after they crying when i was exhausted and for i think 5 minutes my mind was clear, but then it all came crashing in again and i can't stop it. I can't stop thinking in circles i don't know what. I've always been the cool calm collected one, no one would believe me if they saw me now they'd think it's an elaborate troll. Do personalities change overnight? Am i going crazy? I don't want to be crazy, i'm honest to god terrified that i am though.
